assets.name: impact
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production Unreal Engine impact flipbook texture, genuine RGBA transparency. Create ONE square 2048x2048 texture atlas laid out in a precise 4 by 4 evenly sized invisible grid, sixteen sequential animation frames read left to right then top to bottom. Every frame occupies one equal cell and shares exactly the same center/pivot, with transparent gutters of at least 24px; no labels, no numbers, no visible grid. Subject: hand-drawn anime/comic FIST CONTACT EXPLOSION, sharp aggressive irregular zigzag lobes, shattered pointed ink silhouettes and torn lightning. This is the explosion at a fist hitting a body, not a sword slash or a projectile. Color palette: incandescent cream white center, punchy yellow and orange core, thin dark navy torn contour with a few magenta edge fragments. Flat graphic color blocks, crisp 2D animation drawing, high contrast, very limited soft glow. Animation: frame 1 tiny irregular white crack; frame 2 a compressed sharp white contact flash; frames 3-4 violently open into broad jagged asymmetric five-pronged angular explosive masses; frames 5-7 expand, peel into branching blades and zigzag fingers with visible negative gaps; frames 8-11 hollow out irregularly and break into many distinct triangular splinters and short lightning forks; frames 12-15 only scattered small sharp ember fragments moving outward; frame16 only 3 tiny vanishing specks. Size grows then dissipates, do not repeat the same shape. The key silhouettes must look like ink painted comic impact frames, NOT smooth petals, capsules, pills, leaves, rounded diamonds, geometric rings, stars with evenly spaced identical rays, or radial pinwheels. No characters, lettering, environment, floor, watermark, baked checkerboard. All shapes strictly within their cell, transparent empty background throughout.
